preconditions.description: The number of clubs m and students n must be within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= p_i < 5000 for p_i in potentials)
preconditions.description: Each student's potential must be a non-negative integer less than 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i <= m for c_i in clubs)
preconditions.description: Each student's club index must be within the range of 1 to m.
The number of days d must be at least 1 and at most the number of students n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k_i <= n for k_i in leaving_students)
preconditions.description: Each student leaving their club must be a valid student index.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly d lines, one for each day.
Each line of output must be a non-negative integer representing the maximum strength.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i]) == max_strength[i] for i in range(d))
postconditions.description: The output for each day must match the calculated maximum strength for that day.
